_comment: Throwaway config for src/check_model_load.py only -- NOT an evaluation config. Index 0 is the base model (verified 2026-08-17, job 3015981, before training was queued); index 1 is the adapter trained on it (job 3021705, finished 2026-08-18). The fine_tune_map entry was empty while only the base existed, because expand_models then synthesises a '<name>-finetuned' path that does not exist. Run with: sbatch slurm/submit_model_check.sh --config configs/eval_config.candidate.json --model-idx 1. Options must be ARGUMENTS: this cluster does not propagate the submitting environment into jobs.
